summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by WFN Credit Company, LLC reporting an amendment (Seventh Addendum) to a servicing agreement between Comenity Bank and Comenity Servicing LLC. The filing concerns asset-backed securities servicing arrangements, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is a standard contractual update for a credit card master trust structure, with no deal terms or special-situation catalysts.
